name: showup2move
description: Responsive sports matching platform for spontaneous local activities.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @showup2move/shared && npm run build --workspace @showup2move/database && npm run build --workspace @showup2move/web
scripts.container:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.local.yml logs -f web worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @showup2move/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @showup2move/database && npm run typecheck --workspace @showup2move/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @showup2move/shared && npm run test --workspace @showup2move/database && npm run test --workspace @showup2move/web
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
